te.lib:h-niyya: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended…
te.lib:h-qulub: Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth, but He looks to your hearts and to your deeds.
te.lib:h-ridallah: Whoever seeks Allah's pleasure at the cost of people's displeasure, Allah will suffice him against the people. And whoever seeks people's pleasure at the cost of Allah's displeasure, Allah will entrust him to the people.
te.lib:h-khafi: Allah loves the servant who is God-conscious, free from want, and hidden (from the view of people).
te.lib:h-ghadab-julus: When one of you becomes angry while standing, he should sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise he should lie down.
te.lib:h-ghadab-istiadha: Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet ﷺ, and one of them became furious and his face turned red. The Prophet ﷺ said: “I know a word which, if he said it, would remove what he feels: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the outcast.”
te.lib:h-ghadab-sukut: When one of you is angry, he should be silent.
te.lib:h-kazm: Whoever suppresses his anger when he is able to act upon it, Allah, the Exalted, will call him on the Day of Resurrection before all creatures, and let him choose of the maidens of Paradise whomever he wishes.
te.lib:h-rifq: Verily Allah is kind and He loves kindness, and He grants for kindness what He does not grant for harshness.
te.lib:h-rifq-zana: Kindness is not found in anything except that it beautifies it, and it is not removed from anything except that it disfigures it.
te.lib:h-muflis-tabbaan: The believer does not attack people's honour, nor curse, nor commit indecency, nor is he foul-mouthed.
te.lib:h-afw-izz: Charity does not decrease wealth, no one forgives another except that Allah increases his honour, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status.
te.lib:h-zulm-zulumat: Beware of oppression, for oppression will be darkness on the Day of Resurrection; and beware of stinginess, for stinginess destroyed those who were before you.
te.lib:h-dawat-mazlum: Beware of the supplication of the oppressed, for there is no barrier between it and Allah.
te.lib:h-unsur: Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is oppressed. People asked: “O Messenger of Allah! It is right to help him if he is oppressed, but how should we help him if he is an oppressor?” He said: “By preventing him from oppressing others.”
te.lib:h-muflis: Do you know who is bankrupt?… The bankrupt of my Ummah is the one who comes on the Day of Resurrection with prayer, fasting and zakat, but he had insulted this one, slandered that one, consumed the wealth of this one, shed the blood of that one and beaten this one; so this one is given some of his good deeds, and that one some of his good deeds…
te.lib:h-la-darar: There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.
te.lib:h-la-yuldagh: A believer is not stung twice from one and the same hole.
te.lib:h-yuhibbu: None of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself.
te.lib:h-la-tahasadu: Do not envy one another, do not inflate prices against one another, do not hate one another, do not turn your backs on one another, and do not undercut one another in trade; but be, O servants of Allah, brothers…
te.lib:h-hasad-ithnatayn: There is no envy except in two cases: a man whom Allah has given wealth and who spends it rightfully, and a man whom Allah has given wisdom and who judges by it and teaches it.
te.lib:h-hajr-thalath: It is not permissible for a Muslim to forsake his brother for more than three nights, each turning away from the other when they meet; the better of the two is the one who is first to give the greeting of peace.
te.lib:h-istalaha: The gates of Paradise are opened on Monday and Thursday, and every servant who does not associate anything with Allah is forgiven, except a man who has rancour between himself and his brother. It is said: “Wait for these two until they reconcile.”
te.lib:h-islah: “Shall I not inform you of what is more virtuous than the rank of fasting, prayer and charity?” They said: “Of course!” He said: “Making peace between people; for spoiling relations between people is the shaver (that shaves away the religion).”
te.lib:h-mira: I guarantee a house in the outskirts of Paradise for a man who gives up arguing, even if he is in the right.
te.lib:h-afshu-salam: You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not direct you to something which, if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves.
te.lib:h-akhbirhu: When a man loves his brother, he should tell him that he loves him.
te.lib:h-tahadu: Give gifts and you will love one another.
te.lib:h-khalil: A man follows the religion of his close friend; so let each of you consider whom he befriends.
te.lib:h-jalis: The example of a good companion and a bad one is that of a person carrying musk and another blowing a blacksmith's bellows…
te.lib:h-maa-man-ahabb: A person will be with those whom he loves.
te.lib:h-yashkur-nas: He who does not thank the people is not thankful to Allah.
te.lib:h-kafiuhu: If anyone does you a kindness, recompense him; but if you do not have the means to do so, pray for him until you feel that you have recompensed him.
te.lib:h-ghiba: “Do you know what backbiting is?” They said: “Allah and His Messenger know best.” He said: “It is your mentioning your brother in a way he dislikes.” It was said: “What if what I say is true of my brother?” He said: “If what you say is true of him, you have backbitten him; and if it is not true of him, you have slandered him.”
te.lib:h-yaqul-khayran: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should say what is good or keep silent.
te.lib:h-kalima: A servant may utter a word pleasing to Allah without giving it much importance, and because of it Allah raises him in degrees; and a servant may utter a word displeasing to Allah without thinking of its gravity, and because of it he falls into Hell.
te.lib:h-muslim-salima: A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.
te.lib:h-zann: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech; and do not look for others' faults, and do not spy…
te.lib:h-kalima-tayyiba: A good word is a charity.
